_comment: English body for prompt-case-spreadsheet-formula. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output formula, assumptions and a hand-check example; do not pretend the sheet was run.
Inputs: Column definitions, calculation goal, and edge cases.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Write a spreadsheet formula. Columns: {columns}. Goal: {goal}. Output formula, assumptions[], hand_check (inputs and expected result), and edge_cases[]. The formula may reference only given columns; handle blanks and division by zero. State that it was not run in an actual sheet.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.检查点:
- The hand-check example can be verified independently.
- Blanks and division by zero are handled.
- Referenced columns are all defined.
sections.失败分支:
- Formula depends on hidden columns: add definitions or rewrite.
- Uncertain edge result: mark it for manual checking.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
